house_rules: Entries are DETECTION ORACLES first: each one exists to produce a measurable differential (response class, content, or timing), not to dump data.
Payloads are canonical forms from the public record, attributed per entry; backend grammar details come from the cheat-sheet source, not memory.
Bounded proofs (organ doctrine): data extraction, if authorized at all, is one-bit-at-a-time with n_runs recorded - never a bulk dump.
failure_modes are mandatory reading BEFORE closing a hypothesis as negative: an oracle that failed for a listed reason leaves the sink untested, not clean.

prerequisites: injectable boolean position in a WHERE/HAVING clause
entries.oracle: tautology returns the normal result set, contradiction returns empty/different - the PAIR is the oracle; one response alone proves nothing
failure_modes: response identical for both (app-level error handling normalizes empty sets) - fall back to content-marker oracles
query result caching serves the same response for both probes - vary a cache-busting parameter
WAF drops AND 1=1 patterns - switch to HAVING, CASE, or arithmetic variants, and record the WAF fact

entries.technique: UNION column-count enumeration via ORDER BY
prerequisites: injectable ORDER BY or SELECT-list position
entries.probe: ' ORDER BY 1-- then increment the ordinal until error (n+1 = column count)
entries.oracle: error appears exactly when the ordinal exceeds the real column count
failure_modes: app strips/handles ORDER BY (sorting whitelist) - the absence of errors is a FACT about handling, not a negative
injection sits in a subquery/aggregate context where ORDER BY is invalid - switch to UNION NULL probing (INJ-003)

source.title: PortSwigger Web Security Academy - SQL injection UNION attacks

entries.technique: UNION type reconciliation via NULL padding
entries.probe: ' UNION SELECT NULL,NULL,NULL-- (one NULL per column, then replace one at a time with typed values)
entries.oracle: query succeeds with all-NULL; a non-NULLable/typed column error at a specific position maps the column types
failure_modes: column-count mismatch error masks type errors - always pad to the exact count first
backend forbids UNION in the injectable statement type (prepared API contexts) - the class is closed for THIS sink only

entries.oracle: response time inflates by the sleep window on the tautology branch only; run n>=3 with baseline - single slow response is noise, not an oracle
failure_modes: database or driver statement timeout < 5s cuts the sleep - lower the window, raise n_runs
connection pool re-issues mask wall-clock - measure from the client, per request, not aggregate
SLEEP disabled/patched on hardened MySQL builds - fall back to BENCHMARK (INJ-005)
sleep-based probes on production are impact-heavy: bounded runs, operator-approved windows (R7)

source.title: PortSwigger Web Security Academy / cheat sheet (MySQL time-based)

entries.oracle: CPU-bound hashing loop inflates response time proportionally to the iteration count
failure_modes: BENCHMARK is CPU load on the shared DB host - bounded iterations, operator window, prefer SLEEP where allowed
query cache or fast path skips evaluation on contradiction branches

entries.oracle: scalar subquery over pg_sleep blocks the row evaluation for the window
failure_modes: pg_sleep unavailable in the query context (permissions) - fall back to heavy Cartesian counts
statement_timeout < window - same caveat as INJ-004

prerequisites: STACKED QUERIES available in the injection point
entries.oracle: second statement blocks the batch for the window; requires the driver to send multi-statement batches
failure_modes: stacked queries disabled (most default web drivers, PHP/MySQL classic pair alike) - WAITFOR is dead on arrival; verify stack support with a benign stacked probe first
error-based extraction available instead - prefer it (faster, less impact) per organ economy rules

entries.probe: ' AND 1=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM all_users a, all_users b, all_users c)--
entries.oracle: cartesian product size inflates evaluation time; tune the join count for a measurable-but-bounded window
failure_modes: cost-based optimizer short-circuits the count - adjust table choice (dba-views vs all_-views)
heavier load than sleep-based on big catalogs - bounded runs, operator window

prerequisites: verbose errors surfaced to the response
entries.oracle: the XPath argument error echoes the concatenated expression value in the SQL error - version() is the calibration proof; arbitrary expressions follow the same channel
failure_modes: app hides SQL errors (generic 500) - the channel is closed; fall back to boolean/time oracles
WAF fingerprints extractvalue/updatexml - use nested-encoding variants only with the organ's encoding craft, and record the WAF fact

source.title: PortSwigger Web Security Academy - SQL injection (error-based extraction)

entries.oracle: which terminator restores a valid query (200/normal class) fingerprints the backend family - a FACT record, not a finding
failure_modes: framework strips trailing whitespace before -- terminates - use # or /* */ for the same candidate
multiple backends behind a router (read/write splits) - terminators may differ per route; ledger per route, not per host
